locomotion.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted 2D tactical RPG SPRITE SHEET. Exactly4 columns by4 rows,16 separated complete figures, transparent alpha, NO floor/shadow/text/labels/grid/colored fringe. Generous space and no touching silhouettes. Natural feet, readable face/gloves, consistent equipment. Large square sheet, body at least230px high in each human cell. Do not crop any feet/head/weapon. EDIT the supplied bearded warrior reference into a NEW bandit shield fighter in the SAME painted art family. Stocky but proportionate adult man with scarred readable face/dark stubble, battered low iron cap exposing the face, worn chainmail and brown leather over faded RUST RED split tunic, practical small boots/gloves. Right hand a straight one-handed arming sword, LEFT forearm a round weathered WOODEN SHIELD with iron central boss and plain dark rim; NOT a blue heraldic kite shield. Rows2-3: EIGHT sequential IN-PLACE WALK poses, alternating left/right footfalls, relaxed sword/shield, no running.
